_description: BPGV_ROTATION_PORTFOLIO - Macro regime rotation strategy using building permit growth volatility

config._comment_crash_disabled: A1 build: the crash override is RETIRED — the alpha-attribution analysis (docs/bpgv_alpha_attribution_analysis.md) showed it destroyed ~130pp of return over 2011-2026. crash_threshold=-0.99 plus crash_override.trigger.method=fixed_drawdown makes the trigger unreachable; the crash_override block is kept inert for code-path compatibility.
config._comment_cash: Remediation Fix 1: BIL and DBMF live in a cash bucket with zero base weight in normal regimes. They only accumulate weight during crash override and serve as TSM risk-free reference.

crash_override._comment_basket: Tier-1 Change 1: cash + bonds + gold + managed futures. SPY is NOT in the defensive basket (baseline bug: SPY was 32% and the single largest realized loser).

trigger._comment: A1 build: method=fixed_drawdown + crash_threshold=-0.99 (above) makes the crash override unreachable — retired per the alpha-attribution analysis. The volatility_scaled params below are kept for reference only.

exit._comment: Change 4: signal-contingent exit. 5-day min hold, 5-day confirmation window, composite score > 0.55.

rebalance._comment: Tier-2: monthly_only mode available (code-path guarded) but disabled in active config — produced negative targets under the portfolio executor's establishment path. Using wide tolerance bands from remediation.

momentum._comment: Tier-2 W3 reverted — worse performance when combined with W2.

breakout._comment: Tier-2 W2 reverted — worse performance when combined with W3.

config._comment_market_stress: R4 broad-market stress throttle (May 2026). The BPGV paper signal predicts volatility/regime pressure, not fast directional crashes. Latest R3a drawdown autopsy showed 2020 max DD came from carrying high risk-on exposure after SPY had already broken. This daily overlay is intentionally non-optimized: if SPY is down at least 8% over 21 trading days and below its 200-day SMA, halve only the risk-on sleeve and leave the residual as cash. The monthly BPGV allocation is preserved as the base and the overlay is reversible/idempotent.
config._comment_vol_target: A1 deep-analysis follow-on (May 2026). Portfolio-level realized-vol scalar applied after normalize_weights; sum(weights) ≤ 1.0 by design, residual stays as cash. Static-target mode = Moreira-Muir 2017, Harvey et al. 2018. T1.2 dynamic-target mode (enable_dynamic_target=true) reads bpgv_garch_percentile from the macro CSV (Cortes & LaPoint 2025) and interpolates target between target_annualized_min (high σ^GARCH) and target_annualized_max (low σ^GARCH). Promotion of dynamic mode requires the Python IC validation in reports/a1_garch_signal_ic.csv to pass on the hold half.
config._comment_dynamic_target_promotion: Option C from reports/a1_garch_ic_verdict.md (2026-05-23). σ^GARCH passed 7/12 hold-half IC cells (best of any signal tested), strongest on TLT 12m (IC -0.69) and GLD 12m (IC -0.80). Paper's vol-prediction claim significant on full sample (IC +0.27 vs forward realized SPY vol). Hold-half SPY direction CIs contain zero (power-limited at n=85 monthly obs) — flagged but promoted on user decision. Backtest run-id pinned in commit message for traceability vs the static-target baseline.
config._comment_r3a_garch_natural_vol: R3a (May 2026). use_garch_natural_vol=true makes apply_portfolio_vol_target use sigma_natural = bpgv_garch * sqrt(12) * multiplier as the un-scaled sigma input -- decouples sigma estimation from the strategy's own scalar history entirely. Fixes the R1 secondary-feedback bug (reports/a1_r1_r2_review.md sec.2: R1's compute_unscaled_return_stdev was upward-biased when scalars varied across the sigma window, trapping mean scalar at 0.21 and floor binding 43%% of days). Calibration: Python sanity check (May 2026) confirmed multiplier=1.0 gives median sigma_natural_proxy 11.69%% vs A1's empirical 13.08%% (within 11%%), expected mean scalar 0.77, floor binding only 6.7%% of days. Promotion gate: this run must pass HLZ Bonferroni N=30 AND LW vs EW SPY/TLT/GLD AND 2022 >= -32%% AND |fit_sharpe - hold_sharpe| <= 0.10.
config._comment_defensive_sleeve: A1 deep-analysis follow-on (May 2026). Addresses the 2022 hedge failure documented in reports/a1_drawdown_autopsy.md — TLT lost −19.6% and GLD −8.0% during Aug-Oct 2022 while held at ≈45% each (TLT alone was the single largest dollar loser of the entire run, −$38,903). Mechanism: inverse-vol re-allocate within {TLT, GLD}, then if σ_joint > pair_vol_target, scale the pair down and route the slack to BIL. R2 (May 2026): pair_vol_target itself is σ^GARCH-percentile-aware — tightens to pair_vol_target_high_sigma when σ^GARCH percentile ≥ 75 (hold-half IC test passed 4/4 GLD horizons and 3/4 TLT horizons; see reports/a1_garch_signal_ic.csv).
